_purpose: Pre-holdout architecture freeze manifest, V2 -- supersedes LNES59_PRE_HOLDOUT_CODE_MANIFEST.json (V1) for the purpose of gating holdout construction, but V1 is preserved unmodified, not deleted, for chronology.
why_a_v2_freeze_was_needed: Phase 4.1: resolved LNES59-B3-002's open predicate-scoping question (query text corrected, not architecture -- see LNES59_PREDICATE_SEMANTICS.md).
Phase 4.1: resolved LNES59-B2-006's same-root-cause-family query/predicate mismatch (query text corrected, classified NOT AMBIGUOUS_GROUND_TRUTH).

Phase 4.3: resolved the third disclosed scope case (valid scoped uncertainty) -- confirmed working via existing mechanism, no gate code change, but a new disclosed limitation (sparse 2-word value word-fallback) was found and recorded.
Phase 4.4: added LNES59_CANDIDATE_CLAIM_ARCHITECTURE.md, the target structured-claim interface and values_match() rule classification (benchmark adapter vs architectural primitive).

explicitly_not_frozen.cases.json / cases_batch2.json / cases_b: dataset content, not architecture -- scaling to 150 cases (Phase 5) adds MORE of these under the frozen rules, does not modify frozen code. Note: cases_batch2.json and cases_batch3.json DID change in this pass (B2-006, B3-002 query text) -- that is dataset repair, explicitly authorized pre-Phase-5, not a frozen-architecture change.
explicitly_not_frozen.run_case.py, arm_x2.py, run_x2_arm.py, m: harness/runner code -- may still change to support new arms (X0, X1, B0-B4) without re-opening the frozen gate/extraction/schema/predicate-semantics/scope logic
explicitly_not_frozen.test_*.py: test files may grow (new cases need new fixtures) but must not be used to justify changing frozen behavior -- a new failing test against frozen code is a finding to record, not a license to patch the freeze

gate._version_note: UNCHANGED from V1 -- same file, same hash. Phase 4.1-4.3's resolutions needed no gate code changes (the third scope case worked via existing values_match(); B3-002/B2-006 were dataset-side query text fixes).

extraction._version_note: UNCHANGED from V1 -- same file, same hash. See gate.version note above; same reasoning applies.

predicate_schema._version_note: NEW at V2 -- first version. Defines EXACT_PREDICATE, PREDICATE_ALIAS, PREDICATE_SUBTYPE, DERIVED_PREDICATE, UNRELATED_PREDICATE, UNRESOLVED_RELATIONSHIP and the general grounding rule.

scope_semantics._version_note: 1.0 = V1 freeze (_derive_scope() + _claims_beyond_scope(), 2/3 directive cases verified). 1.1 = this freeze -- third case verified working via existing mechanism (no code change, hence gate.version unchanged), disclosed limitation added to taxonomy #17.

temporal_lineage._version_note: Unchanged since V1 -- historical_values mechanism (taxonomy #18), no changes this pass.

candidate_claim_architecture._version_note: NEW at V2 -- documentation/design-boundary only, not implemented. Target structured-claim interface (MODEL TEXT -> CANDIDATE CLAIM -> CANONICAL VALUE -> COMPARISON) and values_match() adapter-vs-primitive classification.

regression_suite_state_at_freeze.test_scope_and_history.py: 8/8 (was 7/7 at V1 -- scope 3/3 now genuinely passes instead of documenting a skip; 1 new disclosed-limitation fixture added)
regression_suite_state_at_freeze._total: 149/149, all green at the frozen commit

known_remaining_limitations_at_freeze: Sparse (2-word) NO_MATCH value tokens (e.g. NO_APPROVAL_ON_RECORD) are vulnerable to a vague hedge false-matching values_match()'s word-fallback without genuinely restating the finding -- disclosed in taxonomy #17, not fixed (see LNES59_PREDICATE_SEMANTICS.md and LNES59_CANDIDATE_CLAIM_ARCHITECTURE.md for context). Phase 5 case authoring should prefer richer value tokens for new NO_MATCH predicates where practical.

CandidateClaim architecture is design-only -- ModelOutput still carries a single free-text asserted_value, not the full structured claim (subject/predicate/canonical_value/displayed_value/scope/effective_time/claim_type/source_reference). Deferred deliberately, not an oversight -- see LNES59_CANDIDATE_CLAIM_ARCHITECTURE.md.
PREDICATE_ALIAS category is defined but has zero real instances in the corpus -- untested in practice, only specified.
No B0-B4 baseline or full X0-X1 sweep has been run -- X2 is the only arm with real empirical data (X2_REAL_RUN_2026-08-08.md, 27/27 dev-set cases).
